Theorem 1.3(i)-(iii), including even and odd literal deletion minimality

O'Meara 63:5 and 63:9, including all three Proposition 2.8(ii) numerical formulas, are internally proved from the principal-unit filtration and finite representative equivalences; report 21

Lemma 8.1(i)-(ii) are proved for actual dyadic local-field structures on the selected finite completions: the continuous finite-dimensional extension is constructed, order scaling holds for every nonzero completed-base-field element, relative quadratic-defect scaling is proved from mapped square approximations, and the completion order, defect, and ramification normalizations are identified with the BONG notions. The exact He--Hu adjacent and two-step coefficient criterion is preserved, and every actual lower good BONG has an actual upper integral-lattice good-BONG realization with precisely the mapped values. This is the strongest conclusion supported by the written proof of Lemma 8.1(iii); the literal identification with the preassigned localized scalar-extension lattice L_P remains open because the cited He--Hu Lemma 2.2 concludes only for some lattice. Proposition 8.2, the global deduction in Theorem 1.5, and Theorem 1.9 are proved conditionally from explicit number-field arithmetic proof-data packages; Proposition 8.2 is derived from positive-definite globalization, localization of integrality and representation, and local-equivalence transport rather than assumed as a final field; Theorem 1.9's finite-place conclusion is derived from separate non-dyadic, dyadic unary, and dyadic higher-rank laws, and its local-to-global step is derived target-by-target from rank and integrality localization plus an explicit strong-approximation representation law; the number-field discriminant/ramification equivalence, both directed uses, the ramified dyadic-prime witness, and positivity are proved; canonical number-field global data defines the dyadic predicate, ramification index, and discriminant proposition from the standard height-one spectrum and derives all arithmetic compatibility fields from a place equivalence; Lemma 8.3, Theorem 1.7, and Theorem 1.8 have only n >= 2 even source-facing endpoints, while Theorem 1.7's rank-independent final contradiction is separately proved from an explicit local-defect premise; no unrestricted odd endpoint is exported; reports 23 and 27-43

The obsolete broader Lemma 7.1(ii) from the publisher and arXiv comparison copies

reviewNotice: The semantic basis is the author-corrected v5 TeX manuscript identified by filename and SHA-256; it is not redistributed. Theorem 1.1, the full local n >= 1 implication underlying Theorem 1.5, the literal even and odd testing families for Theorem 1.3, and Lemma 8.1(i)-(ii) on actual dyadic completions have kernel-checked endpoints. Every actual lower good BONG has an actual upper integral-lattice good-BONG realization with the mapped values, but v5 does not identify this realization with the preassigned localized scalar-extension lattice L_P required by the literal Lemma 8.1(iii). The global deduction in Theorem 1.5, Proposition 8.2, and Theorem 1.9 are conditional over explicit arithmetic proof-data packages; the concrete place equivalence, global lattice/localization, local sum-of-squares, and strong-approximation instances remain excluded. The unrestricted odd statement of v5 Corollary 6.3 is false by a kernel-checked e=2, n=3 counterexample, so Lemma 8.3 and Theorems 1.7-1.8 are exported only for even n >= 2. Report 43 records an exact local source-only Review Kit pass for packaged commit ab1901a and Lean code checkpoint e3b18be: 2,023 payload hashes, a resumed new-extraction 5,682-job build, all nine manifest-selected checks, a 62,917-declaration axiom gate admitting only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound, and exact clean dependency pins. This is not GitHub CI, a release, whole-paper completion, or human semantic sign-off. Grade D records the two authoritative-v5 source gaps and incomplete global coverage; deployment remains disabled.
